ebenezer.description: Comprehensive management system for clinical laboratories with appointment and branch administration.
ebenezer.longDescription: Complete management system for clinical laboratories that allows modifying images and text throughout the page, scheduling medical appointments, managing patient appointments, uploading laboratory services, and registering branches. Includes a complete administrative panel for comprehensive laboratory management.

features.1: Medical appointment and service management by branch
features.2: Content editor for modifying images and text

sitdr.longDescription: University tutoring platform to monitor and manage students' academic progress. Includes tools for tracking tutors and students, detailed academic reports, personalized tutoring plans, and advanced analytics. The system improved tutor efficiency by 30% and student engagement by 25%, enabling data-driven academic interventions and personalized reporting.

features.1: Detailed tracking of tutors and students
features.2: Generation of reports and personalized plans
features.3: Analytics and reporting for academic interventions

danjvic.longDescription: Web platform for a company specialized in the sale and installation of garage doors. Allows managing site content, offered services, and maintaining detailed customer control with their respective warranties.

features.1: Content editor for modifying images and text
features.3: Management and registration of offered services

srg.longDescription: Comprehensive system to automate the management of memberships, check-ins, classes, sales, and cash register control in a gym. The system reduces administrative workload, improves user experience, and optimizes daily operations. Benefits: automation of records, flexibility for memberships and classes, detailed financial control, operational efficiency, and real-time reporting. Achieves a 50% reduction in administrative tasks and enhanced member experience with features like automated check-ins and real-time class scheduling.

features.1: Automated management of memberships and check-ins

webScraping.description: Automated web scraping scripts for data extraction.
webScraping.longDescription: Collection of web scraping scripts developed in Python using libraries like BeautifulSoup, Selenium, and Scrapy. These scripts allow automated extraction of information from websites, processing structured data, and storing it in different formats. They include error handling, respect for wait times between requests, and support for dynamic JavaScript websites.

features.2: Support for static and dynamic websites
features.3: Processing and storage of structured data
features.4: Error handling and respect for robots.txt policies

aiReportGenerator.description: Intelligent report generator with artificial intelligence.
aiReportGenerator.longDescription: Automatic report generation system using artificial intelligence to analyze data, identify patterns, and create professional documents. The system processes information from multiple sources, generates automatic insights, and produces personalized reports with visualizations and detailed analysis. Uses language models to summarize information and create coherent narratives based on analyzed data.

grupoSedico.description: Corporate website for Grupo Sedico México - PET plastic container manufacturer.
grupoSedico.longDescription: Modern and responsive website developed for Grupo Sedico México, a leading manufacturer of PET plastic containers. The platform features product catalog, custom manufacturing services, corporate information, and contact system. Includes conversion-optimized design, featured products sections, information about manufacturing processes, and integrated contact forms. The site reflects the company's brand identity and facilitates communication with potential customers.

features.4: Presentation of services and manufacturing processes

about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a Full Stack developer focused on creating modern, efficient, and scalable web solutions. I have practical experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, SQL, and NoSQL, which allows me to design and implement robust end-to-end applications. I am a Computer Systems Engineer with a specialization in Software Engineering, and I am certified by Google in Cybersecurity, which gives me a comprehensive vision of building secure, reliable, and high-performance systems. I am passionate about technological innovation, continuous improvement, and developing products that provide real value.
